The '''Bresan system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bresan]]. It was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was governed by the [[Pimbrellan League]].
